1, evals. `evals/skills/link-mender/` did not exist, so this run writes the cases and stops; the template waits for goldens and a baseline round.

## Request

> After people move files around, the relative links in our Markdown docs keep breaking and nobody notices until a reader complains. Could you start a skill for implementers that finds each broken relative link under docs/ and points it at the file's new location? Call it link-mender. I looked and found nothing worth borrowing, so it can be written from scratch.
